:::{#def-folds}
#### Folds

A division of a [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$,
indexed by $I$, into $k$ **folds**
is a partition of $I$ into $k$ nonempty, disjoint subsets
$\fold{1}, \ldots, \fold{k}$:

$$
\fold{1} \cup \cdots \cup \fold{k} = I.
$$ {#eq-folds}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

@james2021islr2e [sec. 5.1.3] and @hastie2009elements [sec. 7.10.1],
who split the data into $k$ roughly equal-sized parts.
:::

:::
